title: Head and Neck Oncology Fellowship
inst: Mass Eye and Ear / Harvard Medical School
Department: Department of Otolaryngology–Head and Neck Surgery
Eligibility: Not stated on official page

Application method: Apply via the American Head and Neck Society (AHNS) fellowship process
Summary: One-year fellowship providing advanced training in head and neck oncology, microvascular free flap and pedicled reconstruction, advanced skull base surgery, transoral robotic surgery and thyroid/parathyroid surgery with the Mass General Cancer Center.

title: Neurotology Fellowship
inst: Mass Eye and Ear / Harvard Medical School
Department: Department of Otolaryngology–Head and Neck Surgery

International applicants: Requires ACGME-accredited OHNS residency; not stated otherwise

title: Pediatric Otolaryngology Fellowship
inst: Mass Eye and Ear / Harvard Medical School
Department: Department of Otolaryngology–Head and Neck Surgery
Eligibility: Graduates of an ACGME-accredited otolaryngology–head and neck surgery residency
Summary: One-year ACGME-accredited pediatric otolaryngology fellowship covering Mass Eye and Ear, Massachusetts General Hospital and Shriners Hospital for Children, with high volumes of open airway, complex otology and cleft/craniofacial surgery.

title: Thyroid and Parathyroid Endocrine Surgery Fellowship
inst: Mass Eye and Ear / Harvard Medical School

Application method: US/Canada applicants via AHNS; international applicants by direct application to the programme

title: Facial Plastic and Reconstructive Surgery Fellowship
inst: Mass Eye and Ear / Harvard Medical School
Department: Department of Otolaryngology–Head and Neck Surgery
Eligibility: Not stated on official page

title: Laryngology Fellowship
inst: Mass Eye and Ear / Harvard Medical School
Department: Department of Otolaryngology–Head and Neck Surgery
Eligibility: Certification or eligibility with the American Board of Otolaryngology
Application method: Email CV and three letters of recommendation to the programme coordinator
Summary: One-year laryngology fellowship training fellows in voice, airway and laryngeal cancer care, including phonomicrosurgery, laryngeal framework surgery and airway reconstruction, with links to Harvard and MIT.

title: Rhinology Fellowship
inst: Mass Eye and Ear / Harvard Medical School
Department: Department of Otolaryngology–Head and Neck Surgery
Eligibility: Not stated on official page
Summary: One-year post-residency rhinology fellowship in endoscopic sinus, orbital and skull base surgery with protected weekly academic time.

title: Advanced Head and Neck Surgical Oncology and Microvascular Reconstructive Fellowship
inst: Beth Israel Deaconess Medical Center / Harvard Medical School
Department: Otolaryngology–Head and Neck Surgery
Eligibility: Completed an ACGME-approved residency and board-certified/eligible (ABOto, ABS or ABPS); dual-degree OMFS candidates also eligible
Summary: Fellowship offering broad exposure to head and neck tumour and skull base surgery with free tissue transfer reconstruction and transoral robotic surgery, aligned with neurosurgery, radiation and medical oncology.

title: Fellowship in Head and Neck, Oncologic Skull Base and Reconstructive Surgery

Accreditation: American Head and Neck Society approved
Application method: American Head and Neck Society website

title: Laryngology Fellowship
inst: Johns Hopkins University School of Medicine

Accreditation: Approved by the Johns Hopkins University School of Medicine GME Committee

title: Neurotology Fellowship
inst: Johns Hopkins University School of Medicine
Department: Department of Otolaryngology–Head and Neck Surgery
Eligibility: Completed an ACGME otolaryngology–head and neck surgery residency
Application method: SF Match Central Application Service; interviews July–September
Summary: Two-year neurotology fellowship designed to produce clinician-investigators able to initiate an independent academic neurotology programme.

title: Fellowship in Rhinology
inst: Johns Hopkins University School of Medicine

International applicants: Page states: this programme does not accept international medical graduates
Accreditation: Approved by the Johns Hopkins University School of Medicine GME Committee
Summary: One-year rhinology fellowship at the Johns Hopkins Sinus Center with training in revision and frontal sinus surgery, orbital approaches and endoscopic skull base surgery.

title: Fellowship in Head and Neck Endocrine Surgery

Summary: One-year fellowship (est. 2012) providing advanced training in the surgical and medical management of thyroid and parathyroid disease within a multidisciplinary endocrine programme.

title: Fellowship in Facial Plastic and Reconstructive Surgery
inst: Johns Hopkins University School of Medicine
Department: Department of Otolaryngology–Head and Neck Surgery
Eligibility: Not stated on official page

title: Neurotology Fellowship
inst: University of California, San Francisco
Department: Department of Otolaryngology–Head and Neck Surgery
Eligibility: Not stated on official page
Summary: ACGME-accredited neurotology fellowship across UCSF Medical Center, Zuckerberg San Francisco General and UCSF Benioff Children's Hospital Oakland, with leadership in cochlear implantation and collaborative lateral skull base surgery.

title: Pediatric Otolaryngology Fellowship

title: Facial Plastic and Reconstructive Surgery Fellowship

Eligibility: Not stated on official page

title: Pediatric Otolaryngology Fellowship

title: Facial Plastic & Reconstructive Surgery Fellowship

title: Otology, Neurotology & Skull Base Surgery Fellowship

title: Head & Neck Surgical Oncology & Microvascular Reconstruction Fellowship
inst: University of Michigan Medical School (Michigan Medicine)
Department: Department of Otolaryngology–Head and Neck Surgery
Eligibility: Not stated on official page

Summary: One-year fellowship (est. 2002) in microvascular head and neck reconstruction and maxillomandibular reconstructive and rehabilitative techniques, with a high volume of transoral laser microsurgery resections.

title: Head and Neck Oncology and Reconstructive Surgery Fellowship (Minnesota)
inst: Mayo Clinic School of Graduate Medical Education

title: Neurotology Fellowship (Minnesota)

title: Head and Neck Surgical Oncology Fellowship

title: Head and Neck Surgical Oncology with Microvascular Reconstruction Fellowship

title: Head and Neck Oncologic Surgery Fellowship

title: Rhinology and Skull Base Surgery Fellowship

title: Head and Neck Oncology & Microvascular Reconstruction Fellowship

Eligibility: Not stated on official page

title: Neurotology Fellowship
inst: Penn Medicine (University of Pennsylvania)

Eligibility: Not stated on official page

title: Sleep Medicine Fellowship with Sleep Surgery Track

title: Otology, Neurotology & Skull Base Surgery Fellowship
inst: University of North Carolina at Chapel Hill
Department: Department of Otolaryngology/Head and Neck Surgery

Summary: Two-year clinical fellowship spanning otology, neurotology, lateral skull base and cerebellopontine angle surgery and cochlear implantation (about 300 operative cases a year), linked to the Children's Cochlear Implant Center.

Summary: One-year fellowship in sinonasal inflammatory disease, endoscopic and open anterior and central skull base surgery, allergy and orbital pathology.

title: Pediatric Otolaryngology Fellowship
inst: University of North Carolina at Chapel Hill

Summary: One-year fellowship in surgical and non-surgical aesthetic and reconstructive treatment of the face, neck and cranium, including the UNC Facial Nerve Center.

title: Pediatric Otolaryngology Fellowship
